values.risk_statement_template: Given that [CONDITION], there is a possibility of [DEPARTURE], leading to [CONSEQUENCE].

consequence_scale_1_to_5.3: Moderate (significant reserve loss or single-system degradation)
consequence_scale_1_to_5.4: Major (mission objective or crop survival threatened; near Flight Rule limit)
consequence_scale_1_to_5.5: Catastrophic (crew safety breach, cabin depressurization, or mission loss)

risk_matrix_5x5_bands.LOW_GREEN: Score LxC in {1x1, 1x2, 1x3, 2x1, 2x2, 3x1} -> monitor with standard procedures
risk_matrix_5x5_bands.MODERATE_YELLOW: Score LxC in {1x4, 2x3, 2x4, 3x2, 3x3, 4x1, 4x2, 5x1, 5x2} -> active mitigation and role advisory required
risk_matrix_5x5_bands.HIGH_RED: Score LxC in {1x5, 2x5, 3x4, 3x5, 4x3, 4x4, 4x5, 5x3, 5x4, 5x5} -> Flight Rule block or mandatory pre-commit mitigation

anomaly_resolution_mer_steps: 1. Safe the crew and affected system (immediate Flight Rule protection)
2. Cross-check with an independent instrument to rule out sensor artifact
3. Isolate branches systematically along a fault tree (never shut down the main bus/trunk)
4. Repair or replace on the de-energized / depressurized safe side
5. Reconnect and verify stable telemetry before returning to nominal operations
lessons_learned_debrief_steps: 2. Most influential single-shift decision (counterfactual sensitivity check)
3. Root cause and trade-off explanation with NASA evidence chip
5. Team communication review and persistent engineering upgrade
